title: VLCQ: Post-training quantization for deep neural networks using variable length coding
abstract: arXiv:2610.15092v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Quantization plays a crucial role in efficiently deploying deep learning models on resource-constrained devices. Post-training quantization does not require access to the original dataset or retraining the full model. Current methods that achieve high performance close to baseline results typically require INT8 fixed-point integers. However, achieving higher model compression with lower bit-widths often leads to significant performance degradation. In this paper, we propose VLCQ, a post-training quantization method that relaxes the fixed-point encoding constraint, enabling more flexible exploration of quantization techniques through variable-length encoding. This approach achieves competitive or improved performance while reducing bit-widths, without requiring access to training data or model fine-tuning. translated_title: VLCQ：使用变长编码的深度神经网络训练后量化方法
translated_abstract: 量化在将深度学习模型高效部署到资源受限设备上起着至关重要的作用。训练后量化不需要访问原始数据集或重新训练整个模型。目前能够实现接近基线结果的高性能方法通常需要INT8定点整数。然而，使用更低位宽实现更高的模型压缩通常会导致显著的性能下降。在本文中，我们提出了VLCQ，一种训练后量化方法，它放宽了定点编码的约束，通过变长编码实现对量化技术更灵活的探索。这种方法在降低位宽的同时实现了有竞争力甚至更优的性能，且无需访问训练数据或进行模型微调。在图像分类、分割和目标检测任务上的大量实验表明，VLCQ提升了模型压缩效果。
tldr: 提出VLCQ训练后量化方法，通过变长编码放宽定点编码约束，在更低位宽下实现更高模型压缩的同时保持有竞争力的性能，且无需访问训练数据或模型微调。
en_tdlr: VLCQ is a post-training quantization method that relaxes fixed-point encoding constraints via variable-length coding, achieving higher model compression at reduced bit-widths with competitive or improved performance, without requiring access to training data or model fine-tuning.
